author: Chase Davis
title: Tanner Scott slams door for save in 4-3 win
desc: Tanner Scott struck out one batter in a scoreless appearance to earn the save in Monday's 4-3 win over the Rays.
impact: After Monday's win, Scott now has a 2.40 ERA and 0.73 WHIP with eight saves, one blown save and five holds across 32 appearances. He hasn't allowed a base runner in either of his last two appearances while picking up a pair of saves. He's just behind Pete Fairbanks for 18th in saves.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brad Keller (forearm) placed on IL
desc: The Phillies placed reliever Brad Keller on the 15-day IL with right forearm tendinitis.
impact: Keller will be sidelined for likely at least the next few weeks. Max Lazar was recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Lazar recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Phillies recalled Max Lazar from Triple-A Lehigh Valley.
impact: Lazar will hold a middle-relief role in the Phillies bullpen.

author: Nate Miller
title: Daniel Palencia (elbow) lands on the IL again
desc: Daniel Palencia (elbow) was placed on the IL on Tuesday.
impact: Palencia missed around three weeks on the IL earlier this season. Now, the young fireballer will hit the shelf again due to inflammation in his elbow. Jacob Webb and Caleb Thielbar are likely at the top of the list for save chances in the Cubs' bullpen now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jose Ramirez (hand) undergoes surgery, to miss 5-7 weeks
desc: Jose Ramirez underwent surgery on his fractured left hamate bone on Tuesday.
impact: Nightengale notes that Ramirez is expected to return between the All-Star Game and the trade deadline. He'll miss at least the next month as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Mahle (hamstring) to make rehab start Tuesday
desc: Tyler Mahle will make a rehab start on Tuesday.
impact: It will be the first rehab start for Mahle. His previous scheduled rehab start on Sunday was postponed.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Heliot Ramos (quad) to begin rehab assignment Wednesday
desc: The Giants say Heliot Ramos will begin a rehab assignment on Wednesday with Triple-A Sacramento.
impact: Ramos will figure to play in at least a few rehab games. He could be activated by the end of the weekend or early next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Addison Barger (elbow) nearing rehab assignment
desc: Blue Jays manager John Schneider said Addison Barger is getting close to starting a rehab assignment.
impact: Barger has been hitting off Trajekt pitching machine and throwing 150 feet. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shane Bieber (elbow) to make rehab start Wednesday
desc: Shane Bieber will make his next rehab start on Wednesday for Triple-A Buffalo.
impact: Bieber is aiming to throw 75 pitches. If all goes well, his next start will come back in the majors.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yimi Garcia (elbow) to make rehab appearance Tuesday
desc: Yimi Garcia will make a rehab appearance on Tuesday.
impact: Garcia is expected to re-join the Blue Jays on Wednesday. He could be activated later this week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Daulton Varsho (wrist) resumes swinging
desc: Daulton Varsho resumed swinging in the cage and hitting off the tee.
impact: Varsho said his wrist felt much better than before. He will continue working on Wednesday.

author: Nate Miller
title: Petey Halpin recalled from Triple-A
desc: Petey Halpin has been called up from Triple-A Columbus.
impact: With Angel Martinez (foot) landing on the IL, Halpin will rejoin the Guardians. Halpin spent most of May with the big-league club, going just 5-for-30 at the plate and swiping a couple of bags.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jhonny Pereda optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Mariners optioned Jhonny Pereda to Triple-A Tacoma.
impact: Pereda had some success at the plate in the majors. He'll return to Triple-A with Cal Raleigh activated from the injured list.

author: Nate Miller
title: Angel Martinez (foot) lands on the IL
desc: Angel Martinez (foot) has been placed on the 10-day IL ahead of Tuesday's game in Milwaukee.
impact: There was some hope that Martinez might be able to avoid the IL, but that has not turned out to be the case. This is certainly a blow to the Cleveland lineup, as the 24-year-old has combined 11 homers with nine steals through 66 games this season. Petey Halpin has been recalled in a corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: J.P. Crawford (hand) activated from IL
desc: The Mariners activated J.P. Crawford from the injured list.
impact: Crawford returns for Tuesday's series opener against the Orioles as expected. He has continued to take ground balls at third base as well as shortstop.
